source: Gazette 2054/9 (15 Jan 2018); Motor Traffic (Amendment) Act No. 10 of 2019 — to be confirmed by HQ legal
note: First version of the schedule. To be confirmed by HQ's legal officers before go-live. HQ edits create new versions; this file is only the start. Demerit points are left empty until the national scheme applies (docs/08).

offences.name: Identification marks not displayed or maintained
offences.publicDescription: The vehicle has no number plate, or it is covered, damaged or unreadable.

offences.name: Non-compliance with the rules of the road
offences.publicName: Breaking the rules of the road
offences.publicDescription: Driving on the wrong side, overtaking across a double line, or other rule-of-the-road offences.

offences.name: Driving without proper control of the vehicle
offences.publicDescription: Driving without proper control — weaving, cutting in, or driving carelessly.

offences.name: Failing to keep a safe road position
offences.publicDescription: Not keeping to the correct lane or a safe position on the road.

offences.name: Using a mobile phone or other device while driving
offences.publicDescription: The driver is holding or using a mobile phone while the vehicle is moving.

offences.name: Improper or excessive use of horn
offences.publicDescription: Sounding the horn unnecessarily or for a long time.

offences.name: Emission control regulations violated
offences.publicDescription: The vehicle is giving out thick black or white smoke.

offences.name: Exceeding permitted front seating
offences.publicDescription: More people in the front seat than the vehicle allows.

offences.name: Seat belt not worn
offences.publicDescription: The driver or front passenger is not wearing a seat belt.

offences.name: Riding a motorcycle without a protective helmet
offences.publicDescription: The rider or pillion passenger of a motorcycle is not wearing a helmet.

offences.name: Clinging to a moving vehicle
offences.publicDescription: People are hanging on to the outside or footboard of a moving vehicle.

offences.name: Excessive or prohibited noise
offences.publicDescription: The vehicle makes excessive noise, for example from a modified silencer.

offences.name: Failing to obey road signs or traffic lights
offences.publicName: Ignoring a red light or road sign
offences.publicDescription: Going through a red light, or ignoring a stop, no-entry or other road sign.

offences.name: Unlawful parking or stopping
offences.publicDescription: Parked or stopped where it is not allowed, such as on a pedestrian crossing or a bend.

offences.name: No safety precautions for a broken-down vehicle
offences.publicDescription: A broken-down or unattended vehicle is left without warning signs or lights.

offences.name: Exceeding certified passenger or goods capacity
offences.publicDescription: The vehicle is carrying more passengers or goods than it is allowed to.

offences.name: Exceeding omnibus capacity
offences.publicDescription: The bus is carrying more passengers than it is allowed to.

offences.name: Lorry overloaded beyond permissible weight
offences.publicDescription: The lorry is carrying a load heavier or larger than permitted.

offences.name: Exceeding the speed limit
offences.publicDescription: Driving faster than the speed limit.

offences.name: Revenue licence not displayed or produced
offences.publicDescription: The vehicle's revenue licence is missing or expired.

offences.name: Driving without a licence for the vehicle class
offences.publicName: No licence for the vehicle class
offences.publicDescription: The driver has no licence valid for this kind of vehicle.

offences.name: Driving licence not carried
offences.publicDescription: The driver isn't carrying their driving licence.

offences.name: Disregarding a police officer's directions
offences.publicDescription: Not following a police officer's lawful directions.

offences.name: No valid emission test or fitness certificate
offences.publicDescription: The vehicle has no valid emission test or fitness certificate.

offences.name: Driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs
offences.publicDescription: The driver appears to be under the influence of alcohol or drugs. If someone is in danger, call 119 now.

offences.name: Hazardous driving at a railway crossing
offences.publicDescription: Crossing or stopping on a railway line when it is unsafe, or ignoring crossing signals.

offences.name: Reckless or negligent driving
offences.publicDescription: Driving dangerously or recklessly, putting other people at risk.

offences.name: Permitting a minor to drive
offences.publicDescription: The driver appears to be under the legal driving age.

offences.name: Driving without a valid driving licence
offences.publicDescription: The driver has no valid driving licence.

offences.name: No valid third-party insurance
offences.publicDescription: The vehicle has no valid third-party insurance.
